title: Warning Against Worldliness, Boasting About Tomorrow

questions.question: What causes quarrels and what causes fights among you? Is it not this, that your ____ are at war within you?
questions.explanation: James 4:1 (ESV): "What causes quarrels and what causes fights among you? Is it not this, that your passions are at war within you?"

questions.question: You desire and do not have, so you murder. You covet and cannot obtain, so you fight and quarrel. You do not have, because you do not ____.
questions.explanation: James 4:2 (ESV): "You desire and do not have, so you murder. You covet and cannot obtain, so you fight and quarrel. You do not have, because you do not ask."

questions.question: You ask and do not receive, because you ask ____, to spend it on your passions.
questions.explanation: James 4:3 (ESV): "You ask and do not receive, because you ask wrongly, to spend it on your passions."

questions.question: You ____ people! Do you not know that friendship with the world is enmity with God?
questions.explanation: James 4:4 (ESV): "You adulterous people! Do you not know that friendship with the world is enmity with God?"

questions.question: Therefore whoever wishes to be a ____ of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
questions.explanation: James 4:4 (ESV): "Therefore whoever wishes to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God."

questions.question: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, "God opposes the ____ but gives grace to the humble."
questions.explanation: James 4:6 (ESV): "But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, 'God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.'"

questions.question: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the ____, and he will flee from you.
questions.explanation: James 4:7 (ESV): "Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you."

questions.question: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and ____ your hearts, you double-minded.
questions.explanation: James 4:8 (ESV): "Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded."

questions.question: Be wretched and mourn and weep. Let your laughter be turned to ____ and your joy to gloom.
questions.explanation: James 4:9 (ESV): "Be wretched and mourn and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom."

questions.question: ____ yourselves before the Lord, and he will exalt you.
questions.explanation: James 4:10 (ESV): "Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will exalt you."

questions.question: Do not speak ____ against one another, brothers. The one who speaks against a brother or judges his brother, speaks evil against the law and judges the law.
questions.explanation: James 4:11 (ESV): "Do not speak evil against one another, brothers. The one who speaks against a brother or judges his brother, speaks evil against the law and judges the law."

questions.question: There is only one lawgiver and judge, he who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to ____ your neighbor?
questions.explanation: James 4:12 (ESV): "There is only one lawgiver and judge, he who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?"

questions.question: Come now, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will go into such and such a town and spend a year there and trade and make a ____"
questions.explanation: James 4:13 (ESV): "Come now, you who say, 'Today or tomorrow we will go into such and such a town and spend a year there and trade and make a profit'—"

questions.question: yet you do not know what tomorrow will bring. What is your life? For you are a ____ that appears for a little time and then vanishes.
questions.explanation: James 4:14 (ESV): "yet you do not know what tomorrow will bring. What is your life? For you are a mist that appears for a little time and then vanishes."

questions.question: So whoever knows the right thing to do and ____ to do it, for him it is sin.
questions.explanation: James 4:17 (ESV): "So whoever knows the right thing to do and fails to do it, for him it is sin."

key_verse_text: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you. Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you.
